run_download_blt_weights: run the script to download facebook/blt model weights from Hugging Face Hub into hf-weights
run_snapshot_download: run snapshot_download to fetch the facebook/blt repository and save it locally
create_download_dir: create the hf-weights directory if it does not already exist before downloading
refactor_main: refactor main to accept a custom local directory path instead of hardcoded hf-weights
review_main: review the main function that downloads BLT weights using huggingface_hub snapshot_download
